foreignObject.div: interrupt() is not input(). The graph stops, the entire state is checkpointed, the Python process can die — and Command(resume=…) picks up exactly where it left off. That’s the difference between a chatbot and an agentic workflow.

Routing co-located with state update inside the node.
# just the update; no routing inside the node
Routing in the builder — easier to see at a glance.
A conversation/session ID — NOT a Python or Java thread. Closer to JSESSIONID. Pass it in config={"configurable": {"thread_id": "…"}}.
The checkpointer keys all state by this id. Same id = same conversation; different ids = parallel independent conversations.
① interrupt() ≠ input(). Different abstraction layer; durable across process restarts.
② A checkpointer is mandatory for interrupt(). Compile with workflow.compile(checkpointer=…).
③ thread_id is the session ID. Same id = same conversation, across processes and machines.
